home_title: A trip where nobody feels they lost.
home_lede: A planner for family and group trips. Code does the maths; the language model only writes questions and explanations.
home_accounts_note: Kids and grandma do not need accounts: you add them as profiles and they vote through a link.
how_1_body: One sentence or a recording. The assistant only asks about what changes the plan most.

proof_title: A chatbot plan sounds good until someone checks it.

proof_check_body: Paste a plan from any tool and TuttiTrip counts the problems: opening hours, distances, breaks, budget and accommodation requirements.
proof_price_body: Before the host overrides something, they see what it costs everyone else.
proof_settle_body: Code works out who pays whom, with the fewest transfers. An uncertain receipt reading is marked and needs your confirmation.
closing_title: Build a plan that works for everyone.
about_title: In a group, one person usually plans the whole trip.
about_lede: The child wants a theme park, the teenager something with friends, grandma a museum and a rest, and the partner something cheap and close. Chatbot plans sound good but ignore opening hours, distances and the pace of the slowest person.
about_split_1_body: Fairness solver, plan check, prices, accommodation requirements. No language model: the same input gives the same plan.
about_split_2_body: Interview questions, explanations, reading of pasted plans, offers and receipts.
about_split_3_body: Saving to your calendar, opening an accommodation search. It never buys or books anything on its own.
about_inside_plan_body: Every person rates places and code builds a plan where nobody drops below the floor.
about_inside_check_body: Counts the problems in a plan, including one that came from another tool.
about_inside_expenses_body: You log receipts and the settlement comes out with the fewest transfers.

seo_privacy_description: What data TuttiTrip processes, why, where it goes and how to ask for your account to be deleted. Auth0 sign-in, language models, hosting and browser storage.
privacy_lede: What data TuttiTrip processes about you, why, where it goes and how to ask for it to be deleted. No legal jargon.
privacy_scope: TuttiTrip was built at the HackYeah 2026 hackathon in Kraków. This page describes what the app does today.
privacy_who_title: Who is responsible for the service
privacy_who_p1: TuttiTrip is built by the HackYeah-TuttiTripTeam team. For anything about personal data, write to us through the Contact page (linked at the bottom of this page).
privacy_login_p1: You sign in with a Google or Discord account. Auth0 runs the sign-in: it asks Google or Discord to confirm who you are. The passwords of those accounts never reach us.
privacy_login_p2: From Google or Discord, Auth0 hands the app your name, e-mail address and profile picture. We show them in the app so you can see you are signed in. The TuttiTrip server recognises you by your Auth0 account identifier.
privacy_data_intro: What you save in the app goes to the database of our server and is tied to your account:
privacy_data_trips: trips: name, destination, dates and budget,
privacy_data_people: people on a trip: a first name or nickname, age group and vote weight (profiles the organiser creates, not accounts),
privacy_data_prefs: people's preferences: restrictions, diet, interests and what matters to whom,
privacy_data_invites: invitations: a link with a secret code that gives someone access to a trip,
privacy_data_plans: plans and expenses of a trip.
privacy_data_others: The organiser enters data about other people, children included. Enter only what the plan needs, and only with the consent of those people or their guardians. Diet and restrictions can reveal health or beliefs, so give no more than you must.
privacy_demo_p1: The HackYeah jury can enter the app through a special demo link, without signing in with Google or Discord. The link opens an account with sample data. The app exchanges the code from the link for a short-lived access token (valid for about an hour) and removes the code from the address bar. The token and the invitation code stay only in the memory of the browser tab (sessionStorage), so the session survives a page reload and renews itself quietly when the token expires. Signing out or a failed renewal erases both. The demo data is sample data and we may reset it at any time.
privacy_ai_p1: A language model writes the interview questions, the explanations and the plan drafts. Our code does the numbers, times and prices.
privacy_ai_p2: The model receives the content a task needs, for example the destination and the participants' preferences. We use two kinds of provider. OpenRouter passes the request on to a chosen model (currently Google Gemini). A Qwen model runs on the team's own GPU server. Search by meaning relies on a model that runs on our side.
privacy_ai_p3: We do not train our own models on your data. The rules of OpenRouter and of the model providers it forwards requests to are their own.
privacy_hosting_cloudflare: The site and its proxy to the API run on Cloudflare (Workers). Cloudflare handles the traffic, your IP address included, and may keep technical logs. We also pass the IP address on to the backend.
privacy_hosting_backend: The backend and the database run on a server managed by the team, not on an external database provider.
privacy_hosting_auth0: The data of your sign-in account (name, e-mail, picture) is handled by Auth0.
privacy_assets_p1: The photos on the public pages come from Unsplash (Unsplash licence), but we serve them from our own domain, so Unsplash gets no request when you view the page. We credit the authors next to the photos, and the links to Unsplash open only when you click them. The fonts are ours too.
privacy_assets_p2: We use no analytics tools and no ads.
privacy_osm_p1: We fill our catalogue of places (sights, restaurants and the like) with data from OpenStreetMap, fetched through the Nominatim and Overpass services. We send them only the name of a city, no user data.
privacy_osm_p2: © OpenStreetMap contributors. The data is available under the ODbL licence.
privacy_storage_intro: The site sets no cookies of its own. To work, it saves a few things in the browser's storage:
privacy_storage_theme: the chosen theme, light or dark
privacy_storage_auth0: the Auth0 sign-in session, so you do not sign in every time (also in the installed app)
privacy_storage_join: an invitation code while you sign in, 10 minutes at most
privacy_storage_demo: the demo session: an access token and the invitation code for quiet renewal, until the tab is closed
privacy_storage_reload: a marker that the app reloaded after an update
privacy_storage_outro: The app is a PWA, so its files (code, photos, fonts) also sit in the browser's cache. Auth0 may set its own cookies on its own domain. Clearing the site's data in the browser removes all of this.
privacy_rights_title: Your rights and deleting your account
privacy_rights_p1: You can ask for access to your data, for it to be corrected, deleted or restricted. To delete your account together with the trips and profiles you created, write to us through the Contact page and give the name or e-mail of the account you sign in with.
privacy_rights_p2: We keep the data while your account exists or until you ask for deletion. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the President of the Personal Data Protection Office (UODO) in Poland.
privacy_changes_p1: When what the app does changes, we update this page and the date at the top.
privacy_contact_p1: The HackYeah-TuttiTripTeam team is on GitHub and on the Contact page.

help_weights_body: Five domains (lodging, food, attractions, pace, cost) share a pool of dots. The more dots, the harder the plan protects that domain for this person.
help_alpha_body: α sets how strongly the plan protects the least satisfied. A low α favours total benefit, a high one favours equality. The default is 1, the Nash compromise.
help_floor_body: Below this share of what the person would get alone, the plan gets a problem in the plan check. The solver tries to leave nobody under it.
help_jain_body: A number from 0 to 1 showing how evenly the plan spreads satisfaction across people. 1 means everyone gets the same share of their own maximum.
help_weakest_body: The domain (lodging, food, attractions, pace or cost) where the plan scores worst for a person. We show it instead of one overall grade.
help_cost_body: The sum of prices for places, transfers and lodging for the whole group. Unverified prices are counted cautiously, rounded up.
help_budget_body: The plan will not pass the upper amount without your approval. When it does, we show κ: how many zloty each extra satisfaction point costs.
help_veto_body: A veto, must-see places, opening hours and the budget are conditions the plan never breaks. A veto removes a place from the plan for the whole group.
help_role_body: The host creates the trip and approves the plan. A co-host helps organise. A member fills in preferences and votes.
help_status_body: A person with an account fills in their own preferences. A profile without an account is kept by the organiser, for example for a child.
help_settlement_body: From the recorded receipts we work out who pays whom how much, with as few transfers as possible.

members_error_gone: That person or trip no longer exists. Refresh the view.
members_error_conflict: This can't be done right now. The host has to transfer the host role first.
members_remove_body: {name} will lose access to the trip. Their profile, expenses and balance stay in the trip.
members_transfer_body: {name} becomes the host of the trip and you become a co-host. The new host can remove members and the trip.
membership_pending_body: You were added to this trip. The host sees who is really coming, so confirm your place or leave the trip.
membership_confirmed_body: You confirmed your place. If plans change, you can leave the trip.
membership_host_body: You're the host. To leave the trip, first transfer the host role to someone else.
membership_leave_body: You'll lose access to “{name}”. Your profile, expenses and balance stay in the trip, and the profile can be taken over from an invitation.
membership_pending_notice: We're waiting for you to confirm that you're going on this trip.
admin_users_tagline: TuttiTrip accounts: find one, block it or delete it.
admin_users_no_match_body: We search e-mails and names. Change the filters or clear them.
admin_users_block_body: The account {name} loses access to the app right away, even with a valid token. The data stays and you can unblock it.
admin_users_delete_body: The account {name} will be deleted for good. Trips it hosts pass to a co-host or disappear; memberships disappear, expenses stay.
admin_users_error_forbidden: You aren't allowed to change accounts.
admin_users_error_gone: That account no longer exists. Refresh the list.
admin_users_error_protected: This account can't be blocked or deleted: it is your own or a superadmin's.
admin_users_error_auth0: Auth0 isn't answering or isn't configured. Try again in a moment.
account_settings_name_hint: You'll see the new name everywhere after you sign in again.
account_settings_saved: Saved. The new name appears after you sign in again.
account_settings_error_provider: The login provider sets this account's name. Change it there.
account_settings_error_invalid: That name isn't valid. Use 1 to 100 characters.
account_settings_provider_managed: This account's details come from {provider}. Change them there; TuttiTrip leaves them as they are.
account_settings_password_hint: Change your e-mail or password on the sign-in screen: sign out, then choose “Forgot your password?” on the Auth0 screen.
help_trips_header_body: Every trip you belong to: the ones you created and the ones someone invited you to.
help_trips_new_body: Start with a name. You can add the city, dates and budget later, and the rest is filled in by the group.
help_trips_toolbar_body: Find a trip by name or city and change the order of the list. The settings stay in the page address, so you can send someone a link to the view.
help_trips_list_body: Open a trip by clicking its name. Inside, you add people, invite the family and build the plan.
help_trips_pagination_body: When there are many trips, move between pages and choose how many show at once.
help_trip_header_body: Name, city, dates, budget and your role. This is also the way back to the trip list.
help_trip_settings_body: Change the name, dates and budget, or delete the trip. The organizer and co-organizer see this button.
help_trip_tabs_body: The interview gathers the whole group's wishes, People lists the travellers with their preferences, and Plan shows the finished schedule day by day.
help_people_list_body: Each person has their own profile: constraints, diet and interests. Open a person to set them, because a fair plan depends on it.
help_people_invite_body: Create a link and send it to the family. Everyone fills in their own preferences, no separate trips needed.
help_plan_empty_body: Once people have filled in their preferences, one button builds a plan for the whole group.
help_plan_actions_body: See which version of the plan you are looking at. Print it, or rebuild it after preferences, dates or budget change.
help_plan_summary_body: The total cost for the whole group and where you stay overnight.
help_plan_fairness_body: Shows how much of the plan each person gets, so nobody leaves feeling they lost.
help_plan_days_body: Switch days to see the times, places and costs of every stop.
help_join_trip_body: This is the trip someone invited you to. The name and place let you check the link is the right one.
help_join_name_body: The other travellers see this name in the people list. You can change it later.
help_join_submit_body: After joining you land on the People tab, where you fill in your preferences.
help_people_vote_body: A person without an account gets a link with a QR code. They rate places and veto them through it, without installing anything.
help_members_membership_body: Confirm that you are going, or leave the trip. The host sees who has already confirmed.
help_members_list_body: People who accepted an invitation, with their status and role. The host changes roles, hands over hosting or removes someone from the trip.
interview_first_label: Tell us about the trip in one sentence
interview_first_example: Gdańsk, three days, kids aged 6 and 13, grandma
interview_first_hint: You write once. The assistant asks about the rest with cards, one question at a time.
interview_load_failed_body: The conversation is safe on the server. Try again in a moment.
interview_members_title: The host and co-hosts run the interview
interview_members_body: You can fill in your preferences in the People tab. You'll see the outcome in the plan.
interview_error_auth: Your session expired. Sign in again and your message will be sent.
interview_error_forbidden: You don't have permission to run this trip's interview.
interview_error_busy: The assistant is still answering, or a voice call is going. Wait a moment and try again.
interview_error_session: The interview session was not found. Reload the page.
interview_error_offline: The connection to the assistant dropped. Your message is still here, you can send it again.
interview_error_failed: The assistant didn't answer. Your message is still here, you can send it again.
interview_swipe_hint: Swipe the card right for yes, left for no. The buttons do the same.
interview_family_empty: Add the people who are going.
interview_family_invalid: Enter a name and an age from 0 to {max}.
interview_panel_description: What the assistant has worked out. You can correct it and the assistant will use your fix.
interview_panel_empty: Nothing yet. Tell us about the trip in one sentence.
interview_panel_locked: The assistant is saving data. You can edit again once it has answered.
interview_trip_edit_description: Changes are saved at once, and the assistant uses them in its next answer.
interview_error_spend_limit: The interview cost limit has been used up. Try later, or fill in the details in the People tab.
interview_error_timeout: The assistant took too long. Try again.
interview_error_unavailable: The assistant is temporarily unavailable. Try again in a moment.
interview_voice_ended: Call ended. The transcript is saved in the interview history.
interview_voice_ai_notice: You are talking to an AI-generated voice.
interview_voice_captions_wait: Captions appear once someone starts talking.
interview_voice_problem_unsupported: This browser does not support voice calls. Type your sentence in the box below.
interview_voice_problem_denied: Microphone access was refused. Allow it in the browser settings, or type your sentence in the box below.
interview_voice_problem_busy: The assistant is answering a message, or another call is running. Try again in a moment.
interview_voice_problem_budget: The voice time limit has been used up. Type your sentence in the box below.
interview_voice_problem_unavailable: Voice calls are temporarily unavailable. Type your sentence in the box below.
interview_voice_problem_auth: Your session expired. Sign in again.
interview_voice_problem_failed: The voice connection failed. Type your sentence in the box below, or try again.
voice_activity_finishing: Filling in the details from the call…
voice_mic_muted: Microphone muted while the assistant answers
voice_mic_muted_ptt: Microphone off; it listens while you hold the button
voice_elsewhere_voice: A voice call is running on another device or in another tab.
voice_elsewhere_text: The assistant is still answering a message. Try again in a moment.
interview_build_waiting: Building once the assistant is done…
interview_build_hint: A preliminary plan from what I know. I fill the gaps with assumptions, which you will see in the plan.
interview_build_error_no_city: Name the city first. Tell the assistant where you are going, for example “Gdańsk”, then try again.
interview_build_error_forbidden: The host or a co-host builds the preliminary plan.
interview_build_error_offline: No connection. The plan was not built, try again when the network is back.
interview_build_error_failed: Could not build the plan. Try again in a moment.
interview_resume_complete: We have settled: {known}. Nothing is missing, you can build the plan.
plan_draft_body: Built from what we know so far, so some of the data is assumed. Finish the interview and recalculate the plan before you send it for approval.
plan_draft_assumption_budget: No budget: the plan does not limit costs.
plan_draft_assumption_preferences: Default preferences for people who have not given theirs yet.
proposal_tally: Approved: {approvals} of {members}. Rejected: {rejections}. Remarks: {comments}. Waiting for: {waiting}.
proposal_without_account: No account in the app, their opinion comes from a voting link: {names}.
proposal_outdated_host: The plan changed after this proposal was sent, so nobody can answer it any more. Send the current version.
proposal_outdated_member: This proposal is about an older version of the plan. The host will send a new one, then you can answer.
proposal_send_body: People with an account get a notification and approve the plan, reject it or leave a remark.
proposal_send_blocked: This is a preliminary plan built on assumptions. Recalculate it from complete data before sending it for approval.
proposal_error_send_forbidden: The host or a co-host sends the plan for approval.
proposal_error_send_outdated: The plan changed in the meantime. The newest one is shown, check it and send again.
proposal_error_send_failed: Could not send the plan. Try again in a moment.
proposal_error_answer_outdated: The plan changed after the proposal was sent. Wait for the host to send a new version.
proposal_error_answer_forbidden: You cannot answer proposals on this trip.
proposal_error_answer_failed: Could not save your answer. Try again.
proposal_load_failed: Could not load the plan approval.
proposal_mine_approve: You approve this plan. You can change your mind.
proposal_mine_reject: You reject this plan. You can change your mind.
proposal_mine_comment: You left a remark on the plan. You can change your mind.
proposal_remark_placeholder: For example: too much walking on the second day
proposal_remark_hint: A remark is optional when you reject. “Leave a remark” needs text.
calendar_hint_ready: Everyone with an account approved the plan. You can download it as an .ics file.
calendar_hint_locked: Available once everyone with an account has approved the plan.
calendar_card_title: Add the plan to your calendar?
calendar_card_description: The approved version {version} of the plan.
calendar_card_events: Every place in the plan is a separate event, in the city's local time.
calendar_card_no_sync: The file does not sync. When the plan changes, download it again.
calendar_card_phone: On a phone the file opens a calendar preview, where you confirm adding the events.
calendar_done: Downloaded. Open the file to add the events to your calendar.
calendar_error_not_approved: This plan is no longer approved by everyone. Refresh the view.
calendar_error_forbidden: You have no access to the calendar file of this trip.
calendar_error_offline: No connection. Try again when the network is back.
calendar_error_failed: Could not download the file. Try again in a moment.
trip_voice_description: Just give it a name. You'll tell the assistant the rest live.
trip_voice_hint: After saving you'll go straight to the conversation with the assistant.
interview_voice_begin_body: The trip is ready. Turn on the microphone and tell the assistant where you are going and with whom.
notif_drawer_description: The latest notifications and a link to the full history.
notif_empty_body: When someone joins a trip or a plan waits for your decision, you will see it here.
notif_veto_added_body_anon: Someone vetoed a place in the plan.
notif_proposal_waiting_title: A proposal waits for a decision
notif_proposal_waiting_body_anon: A change proposal waits for your decision.
notif_budget_waiting_body_anon: The plan exceeds the budget and waits for your approval.
notif_plan_ready_body: You can review it and send your comments.
notif_page_tagline: The history of what happened on your trips.
notif_login_required_title: Sign in to see your notifications
notif_no_match_body: Change the filters or clear them to see the whole history.
notif_select_page: Select all notifications on this page
notif_mark_failed: Could not mark the notifications. Try again.
notif_dialog_missing_body: It may have been removed or be older than the latest hundred. Look for it in the list.
place_card_description: Card from Google, for reference only. The plan uses hours and prices from our own sheet, not from Google.
checkin_lead: Where everyone stays and in which room. Everyone on the trip can see it.
checkin_empty: Nobody has entered where they stay yet. Set yours so everyone knows where to find you.
checkin_dialog_description: Enter where you stay and the room number. Everyone on the trip will see it.
checkin_accommodation_max: The name can be at most 200 characters.
checkin_room_max: The room can be at most 20 characters.
photos_lead: The trip's shared gallery. Photos are shrunk on your phone and location data is removed.
photos_author_left: a person who left the trip
photos_empty_body: Add the first photo from the trip so everyone can see it.
photos_no_match_body: Change the filter to see other photos.
photos_error_not_image: This file is not a photo.
photos_error_rejected: The server rejected the photo: too large, wrong format or the trip's photo limit is reached.
photos_error_forbidden: You cannot add photos to this trip.
photos_error_failed: Could not add the photo. Try again.
locations_empty_body: When someone turns sharing on, you will see their last position here.
share_explain: You share nothing by default. Once on, the app sends your position every few minutes, only while it is open, and people on this trip see your last position and when it was updated. We keep no route history. A position disappears after 15 minutes without an update, and your consent ends after the time you pick. You can turn it off at any time.
share_on: You are sharing your location until {time}.
share_denied: The browser has no permission to locate you. Allow it in the site settings (on iPhone also for the home-screen app) and try again.
share_unavailable: Could not get your position. Check that location is turned on on your phone.
share_unsupported: This browser cannot get your position.
share_failed: Could not change sharing. Try again.
checkin_save_ended: The trip is over, so check-ins are closed.
share_resume_hint: Sharing is on, but not from this window. Nothing is sent until you resume it.
share_send_failed: Your consent is saved, but the position could not be sent. Try resuming sharing.
photos_error_heic: This browser cannot read HEIC photos. Use the "Most compatible" camera format or send a JPEG.
expense_empty_body: Enter the first expense: the amount, who paid and who chips in. The settlement works itself out.
expense_no_match_body: Change the filters or clear them.
expense_forbidden_body: The people on this trip see the expenses. Ask the host.
expense_form_description_modal: The amount, who paid and who chips in.
expense_issue_value_missing: Enter a positive number for every person ticked.
expense_error_amount: Enter an amount above zero with up to 10 digits and two decimal places.
expense_error_date: Choose the date of the expense.
expense_error_description: The description can have at most 200 characters.
expense_error_nobody: Tick at least one person who chips in.
expense_error_currency_required: The trip has no currency, and the expense needs one.
expense_error_payer_not_on_trip: The person who paid is not on this trip.
expense_error_participant_not_on_trip: One of the people is not on this trip.
expense_error_participant_duplicated: The same person is on the list twice.
expense_error_value_missing: Every person needs a value for this split method.
expense_error_value_not_allowed: An equal split takes no values.
expense_error_percent_sum: The percentages must add up to 100.
expense_error_value_positive: Every value must be above zero.
expense_error_forbidden: Only the author, the host or a co-host can change this expense.
expense_error_save_failed: Could not save the expense. Try again.
expense_delete_body: The expense "{title}" leaves the list and the settlement is worked out again.
expense_delete_failed: Could not delete the expense. Only the author, the host and a co-host can.
settlement_empty_body: Add expenses and who pays whom shows up here.
settlement_transfers_none: Everyone is even, nobody transfers anything.
expense_form_currency_hint: The trip has no currency, so choose one for this expense.
settlement_closed_note: The settlement is closed. The host has to reopen it before anyone adds, changes or deletes an expense.
expense_error_closed: The settlement is closed. The host has to reopen it to change expenses.
expense_error_currency_unsupported: This currency is not supported. Choose another.
expense_error_rate_not_found: There is no exchange rate for that day (it may be a weekend or a holiday). Pick another date or the trip's currency.
expense_error_rate_unavailable: Could not fetch the exchange rate. Try again in a moment.
voice_ptt_hint: Let go to send. The call goes on; the square ends it.
voice_always_listen_hint: The microphone listens all the time and picks up background sounds too. By default it listens only while the button is held.
